description: This file defines the React component 'UserManagementPage' which manages user data, specifically for approving mechanics. It includes functions for loading user data, approving mechanics, and rendering the UI with a table of users.

methods.name: roleLabel(role)
methods.description: A helper function to return a human-readable label for mechanic roles, specifically 'approved_mechanic'.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch user list and update component state.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Asynchronous function to approve a mechanic by ID and refresh the user list.
